verdict.rationale: SerpApi's docs describe dedicated vertical endpoints. These include a Google News API that scrapes news.google.com, with topic-token category filters such as World, Business, and Technology. There is also a Google Finance API for stock data, plus separate Flights, Events, Shopping-related, and Autocomplete engines. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of an images vertical endpoint, the Finance markets parameter is restricted to 'indexes' after a Google update, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the vertical endpoints.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can query dedicated verticals like news, images, or finance through specific endpoints or category filters

citations.quote: Our Google News API allows you to scrape results from the Google News search page.
It is used for accessing the news results for a specific topic (e.g., "World", "Business", "Technology").
Extract stock performance, values, price movements, related news, and more.
